items.subject: english-literature-aqa
items.title: Characters: Sheila, Eric, Gerald and Mrs Birling
items.reason: The video teaches a fabricated direct quote for Eric ('he's been here and we all know what we did') and incorrectly claims Mrs Birling is the only character who never accepts responsibility (ignoring Mr Birling).

mark_affecting.quote: He says, 'he's been here and we all know what we did.'
Mrs Birling is the only character who never accepts any responsibility.

items.subject: science-aqa
items.title: Electromagnetic Induction and Transformers
items.reason: The video incorrectly claims that using a stronger magnet increases the frequency of the generator output, which would lose marks on a GCSE exam.

mark_affecting.quote: If you spin that generator faster, or if you swap in a stronger magnet, you actually get a dual effect... the frequency of the output goes up too

items.subject: science-aqa
items.title: Magnets, Electromagnetism and the Motor Effect
items.reason: The video incorrectly claims permanent magnets are made of iron, which contradicts the core GCSE distinction between soft iron (temporary/electromagnets) and steel/alloys (permanent magnets) and would lose marks in an exam.

mark_affecting.quote: They produce their own permanent magnetic field and are usually made of specific materials, like iron, steel, nickel or cobalt.

items.subject: classical-civilisation-ocr
items.title: Death & Burial
items.reason: The video incorrectly instructs students that the coin could be placed on the eyes rather than solely in the mouth, which risks losing marks on specification recall questions.

mark_affecting.quote: placed inside the mouth or resting on the eyes of the deceased

items.subject: classical-civilisation-ocr
items.title: Foundation Myths: Athens & Rome
items.reason: The video incorrectly attributes the founding of Alba Longa to Aeneas instead of his son Ascanius (Aeneas founded Lavinium), which would cost marks on foundation sequence questions in GCSE Classical Civilisation.

mark_affecting.quote: Aeneas flees west, and eventually founds a settlement in Italy called Alba Longa.

items.subject: classical-civilisation-ocr
items.title: Journeying to the Underworld
items.reason: The video incorrectly presents Persephone's time division as an equal half-year seasonal split (spring/summer vs autumn/winter) rather than the prescribed Homeric Hymn's one-third below and two-thirds above, and attributes Virgil's 100-year wait to lacking an obol rather than being unburied.

mark_affecting.quote: She now splits her year: spring and summer above ground with her mother... and autumn and winter below ground as queen of the underworld

If you didn't have this exact coin, the obol, placed on your body when you were buried, your soul was literally stranded on the muddy riverbank of the Acheron for a hundred agonizing years before Charon would finally take you across for free.

items.subject: history-aqa
items.title: Russia in 1894: Economy and Society
items.reason: The video prominently states in audio and on-screen graphics that only 14% (one in seven) of the empire were ethnic Russians, which is severely inaccurate compared to the census figure of roughly 44% ('fewer than half').

mark_affecting.quote: only about one in seven, yeah just 14% were actually ethnic Russians

items.subject: history-aqa
items.title: War Communism, Kronstadt and the NEP
items.reason: The video states that the 1921–22 Volga famine was caused by losing Ukraine under the 1918 Treaty of Brest-Litovsk, giving students an incorrect cause and anachronistic sequence for an examined syllabus topic.

mark_affecting.quote: and losing Ukraine's grain belt from the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk, this huge drop in farming triggered a catastrophic famine in the Volga region in 1921 and 1922

items.subject: history-aqa
items.title: Terror, Purges and the Cult of Stalin
items.reason: The video states that five of eight Red Army marshals were executed (there were only five marshals, three of whom were shot) and claims Trotsky was airbrushed out of photos of Lenin's funeral (he was absent from the funeral).

mark_affecting.quote: Five of the Red Army's eight marshals? Executed.
Five of the Red Army's eight marshals? Executed.
Trotsky was famously airbrushed out of pictures of Lenin's funeral.

items.subject: history-aqa
items.title: The Great Patriotic War, 1941-1945
items.reason: The video states that Stalin signed the German surrender in Berlin on 9 May 1945, whereas Stalin signed nothing and Marshal Zhukov signed for the Soviet Union.

mark_affecting.quote: That push, ultimately ended with Stalin signing the German surrender in Berlin on the 9th of May 1945, which became Victory Day.

items.subject: drama-aqa
items.title: Performance Interpretation: Rani Standing Her Ground
items.reason: The video explicitly claims Abdul 'doesn't speak English' upon arriving at Windsor Castle (03:22), which contradicts the set text and would cause a student to lose marks for textual inaccuracy in their exam.

mark_affecting.quote: Just picture his arrival at Windsor Castle. He doesn't speak English, and he is acutely aware of how much he stands out.
